phase: FIX-2 client polling budget + terminal-state handling
problem: The report-preview client gave up after CF_MAX_POLLS=6 x 5s = 30s while the server stale/takeover window (DEFAULT_STALE_MS) is 90s. A slow-but-healthy generation therefore showed a premature '生成失败 / 生成超时' screen even though the server was still working. Terminal-state handling also had gaps: a server-side explicit status='failed' was not recognised, and the timeout screen could misrepresent a still-generating server as a failure.

changes.BUDGET: pages/report-preview/report-preview.js — CF_MAX_POLLS 6 -> 24 (24 x 5s = 120s), >= the 90s server stale window so the client never abandons a healthy generation. Still strictly bounded (no infinite polling).
changes.TERMINAL_STATES: Explicit handling for generating | ready | failed | error. A server-side data.status==='failed' now stops polling immediately and shows a controlled retry. ready stops polling immediately. error (missing recordId) unchanged.
changes.SOFT_TIMEOUT: When the client budget is exhausted the page no longer claims server failure: it sets cfSoftTimeout=true with a neutral '报告仍在生成中，请稍后重试' message + controlled retry (the server may still be generating).
changes.NO_DUP_LOOPS: New _stopPoll() single point that clears the in-flight timer before any reschedule; _schedulePoll() always clears first and the timer callback nulls _cfPollTimer → at most ONE live poll loop at any time.
changes.UNLOAD: onUnload() calls _stopPoll() (clears the timer) and sets the unloaded flag → no timers survive page exit.
changes.WXML: report-preview.wxml failed-state description falls back to cfMsg (already bound); no structural change.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/report-preview-wiring.test.js — P4 updated to the new bounded/soft-timeout semantics; added T1..T5: polls beyond the old 30s cap without premature failure, stops at ready, stops at server failed (+retry), unload cancels polling, no duplicate poll loops (single live timer).

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>. Pure client change; rebuild preview. No server/schema/env impact.
